# Bicycle workshop
## Chain repairs
Bicycle maintenance includes chain inspection. Replace damaged links and apply lubricant.
## Brakes
Bicycle brakes need cable adjustment. Check stopping distance after each repair.

# Solar array
## Energy output
The solar array produces 19 kWh of energy daily. Panels cost 2400 units.
## Maintenance
Clean panels monthly and inspect the inverter.

# Wind turbine
## Energy output
The wind turbine produces 14 kWh of energy daily. Equipment costs 3200 units.
## Maintenance
Inspect bearings and rotor balance quarterly.

# Ridge weather
Afternoon rain arrives quickly. Carry waterproof clothing and identify shelters before departure.

# Café Reykjavík
The café serves coffee beside the harbour. Naïve sketches decorate the windows.

# Desert tortoise
The tortoise shelters in burrows during hot afternoons and eats grasses.

# Ceramic glazing
Mix cobalt pigment into glaze and fire the clay bowl slowly.
